name: YeeZi
name_zh: 深圳市冶治科技有限公司
summary: YeeZi is a Shenzhen-based supplier and developer of servo motor control, multi-axis control and robot-joint motor-driver hardware. Its three named hardware lines are ServoEdge, ServoX and ServoMotor, covering motor-control development, system integration and robot-joint integration. The official company address is in Nanshan District, Shenzhen.
categories: Robot Control Boards and Computing Components
